sentences.text:
Mr. Ritesh Pandey, Advocate
 for the complainant.

This is a petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No.187 dated 17.11.2022 under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC, 1860 and Section 24 of the Emigration Act, 1983 registered at Police Station Dasuya, District Hoshiarpur.
Vide order dated 22.12.2022 while granting interim protection, the petitioner was directed to join investigation and was required to give two DD's of Rs.1 lac each to the complainant.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that pursuant to order dated 22.12.2022,
petitioner has paid the amount of Rs.2 lacs to the Investigating Officer and further has been given to complainant and petitioner has joined the investigation and as such his interim bail may be made absolute.

The learned State counsel, on instructions from ASI Bhupinder Singh has affirmed the fact that the petitioner has joined the investigation and his further investigation in the present case is not required.

In view of the above, interim order dated 22.12.2022 is made absolute subject to compliance of conditions as envisaged under Section 438 (2)
